meta.description: Estimate causal effects of an exposure on an outcome from GWAS summary statistics using genetic instruments. Implements IVW (fixed/random), MR-Egger, weighted median/mode, MR-RAPS, CAUSE, GSMR-HEIDI, MR-PRESSO, MVMR, MR-Clust, LCV, and LHC-MR via TwoSampleMR, MendelianRandomization, MR-PRESSO, cause, and lhcMR. Use when testing causal direction between traits, evaluating drug-target effects via cis-pQTL/cis-eQTL, performing multivariable mediation MR, distinguishing causation from correlated horizontal pleiotropy, or producing STROBE-MR-compliant sensitivity batteries.
meta.auditor_independence: This report was written by an auditor who did not perform either fix round.
meta.note: 11 inputs = all 9 inputs from the prior (87-score) re-audit re-run as regression tests (1-9, same scenarios, re-generated from scratch against commit dfecae6db0054269a6e0510d49ae3395fab93070; Input 1 also carries the original P0 MR-PRESSO real-data regression forward), plus 2 new auditor-authored inputs (10-11) targeting the two P2 fixes dispatched in this round: the qhet_mvmr conditional-F<1 guard and the Steiger directionality_test() NULL guard.

Every statistic was independently computed this session against real (GIANT BMI15 x PGC MDD18) or clearly-labelled synthetic data with disclosed planted ground truth; the CAUSE crash was reported as a crash, not dressed up as a success.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled methodological fallacy found. Both round-2 fixes strictly improve methodological soundness: the MVMR section no longer implies qhet_mvmr is safe below its actual reliability floor, and the Steiger section no longer lets an agent silently trust a NULL result as a directionality conclusion.

The one code-usability-type failure (Input 8, CAUSE crashing inside cause 1.2.0.335's in_sample_elpd_loo() against installed loo 2.10.1) is a package-version defect in the environment, not in any file this Skill ships -- SKILL.md's CAUSE section is prose plus a pointer to the sibling pleiotropy-detection Skill, not runnable code here, unchanged from the prior audit's determination and confirmed unchanged (identical error) in this round's re-run.

key_strengths: Both round-2 P2 fixes are independently reproduced and verified end to end: the qhet_mvmr condF<1 guard fires exactly at the prior audit's own condF=0.87/0.78 finding, making the previously-observed sign flip on exposure2 unreachable (Input 4); the Steiger guard now raises a clear stop() instead of the pre-fix silent NULL (Input 5).

The Steiger fix is proven to work, not just to fail loudly: Input 11 shows the documented samplesize_col pattern makes directionality_test() genuinely succeed and correctly discriminate a planted forward direction (TRUE) from its reverse (FALSE) on a fresh synthetic dataset.

The MVMR guard is correctly scoped, not over-broad: Input 10 confirms it does not fire at conditional F ~2.2, so SKILL.md's documented qhet_mvmr fallback still runs in the ordinary weak-instrument regime it is meant for.

The original P0 (MR-PRESSO signif() crash on a character-valued Global Test Pvalue) remains fixed under a second, independent re-run on the same real GIANT-BMI15 x PGC-MDD18 data that first exposed it.

recommendations.title: CAUSE still crashes inside its own ELPD model comparison against the installed loo version
recommendations.problem: Following SKILL.md's documented CAUSE workflow with 147 sig SNPs (above the stated >=100 floor) still crashes inside cause():::in_sample_elpd_loo() with 'non-numeric argument to binary operator' -- identical to the prior re-audit's finding, confirmed unchanged by round 2.
recommendations.root_cause: cause 1.2.0.335's in_sample_elpd_loo() calls loo_compare() and indexes its return value assuming a shape the installed loo 2.10.1 no longer produces -- a package-version incompatibility, not a coding error in any file this Skill ships (its CAUSE section is prose plus a pointer to causal-genomics/pleiotropy-detection, not inline code).
recommendations.fix: Add a version-pinning note to SKILL.md's CAUSE section (e.g. 'verified against cause X.Y + loo Z.W; if cause() crashes inside in_sample_elpd_loo, check for a loo_compare() return-shape mismatch') so an agent hitting this doesn't mistake it for its own error. Carried forward unfixed from the prior audit; explicitly out of scope per the round-2 fix log.

recommendations.title: qhet_mvmr's fallback stays imprecise (though correctly signed) through most of the condF 1-10 range, and SKILL.md doesn't say so
recommendations.problem: At conditional F ~2.2 (above the round-2 guard's condF<1 floor), qhet_mvmr's point estimates were correctly signed but wide and imprecise (Exposure1 0.44 [0.118, 0.875] vs true 0.30; Exposure2 -0.26 [-0.665, 0.159] vs true -0.10) -- the guard correctly does not fire here, but an agent reading only the guard's condF<1 threshold could over-trust the point estimate anywhere above it.
recommendations.root_cause: The round-2 fix documents a floor below which qhet_mvmr becomes unreliable (sign flips), but does not caveat that between that floor and the IVW-safe condF>10 threshold, the fallback is directionally usable but not yet precise.
recommendations.fix: Extend the round-2 caveat paragraph to note that condF in roughly the 1-5 range still yields wide confidence intervals even when correctly signed, and that the point estimate should be reported with its CI, not as a precise correction, until condF approaches 10.
